scope: current working tree, including uncommitted Phase-2 work
scientific_evidence_policy: Deterministic smoke, dev, and local-stub runs are engineering artifacts only.

current_architecture.schemas: Pydantic schemas for tools, actions, tasks, interventions, instances, trajectories, and scores.
current_architecture.generation: Deterministic synthetic generation with quality reports, splits, and audit samples.
current_architecture.tools: Schema-native deterministic simulated tools plus legacy mock tool support.
current_architecture.environment: Local simulated benchmark environment with intervention patches and max-step termination.
current_architecture.agents: Deterministic baselines, local-stub LLM agents, provider-backed clients, registry, and aliases.
current_architecture.runners: Experiment config validation, execution, metadata, resume, error logging, and cost estimation.
current_architecture.metrics: Final success, tool use, recovery, contradiction, memory, stopping, trajectory quality, ACRS, and rankings.
current_architecture.analysis: Run loading, tables, figures, error-case mining, and paper-asset export.
current_architecture.phase2: Config validation, dry-run planning, intervention audit, dataset freeze, run summary, and claim-ledger update helpers.

duplication_or_legacy_seams: metrics/components.py is legacy BenchmarkTask support while scoring.py uses newer metric modules.
tools/mock_tools.py is legacy support while tools/simulated.py is schema-native.

safety: No live web tool by default.

gaps: Provider integration tests skipped without API keys.

No metric calibration tests against human labels.

risks: Provider HTTP error bodies should be redaction-reviewed before real runs.
